decision.basis: Conservative compatibility decision for the fixed D7 OHLCV contract: the r=0 source-compatible proposal leaves a permanently inactive hidden feature subnetwork under the source-style zero-bias/ReLU initialization. No replacement TiDE body is implemented by this audit.

locators.finding: MLPResidual uses Dense-ReLU, Dense output, Dense skip and optional LayerNorm; no initializer overrides.
[64,4] constructs one residual block whose incoming dimension follows the supplied feature tensor.
Time feature encoder is retained and temporal decoder emits one scalar per horizon step.
Both past and future dynamic features pass through the same time encoder; their encodings enter the dense encoder and final temporal decoder.
Official defaults include hidden256, num_layers2, decoder_output_dim4, final_decoder_hidden64, transformFalse, layer_normFalse.
Creates hidden_dims=[hidden_size]*num_layers, time_encoder_dims=[64,4] and passes transformation/normalization flags.
ETTh1 presets use transformTrue and layer_normTrue; those task presets are distinct from the unactivated defaults candidate.

paper.title: Long-term Forecasting with TiDE: Time-series Dense Encoder

locators.description: Concatenation of history, projected past/future covariates and static attributes into encoder.
Dense and temporal decoders, direct future-covariate highway and global linear residual.

paper.verification_scope: Paper descriptions and locators are cited from the existing full-text review; the original PDF was not newly downloaded or re-read during this narrow compatibility probe.

unactivated_candidate.interpretation: Treat the five observed OHLCV channels as five shared-body scalar series, emit five one-step forecasts and use an external Linear(5,1)+Softplus task head. No sigma7 history is supplied.
unactivated_candidate.preset_basis: Coherent official train.py defaults, not the ETTh1 selected configuration and not a numerical paper reproduction.
unactivated_candidate.reason_not_activated: For r=0, the [64,4] residual time encoder has zero-width input matrices. The zero hidden bias passes through ReLU at zero, preventing learning of the hidden bias and subsequent hidden projection; only output/skip biases can learn. Removing or fusing this branch, changing its initialization, or adding covariates would require a separate explicit adaptation, which is not approved as a published-body restoration here.

probe.scope: Bounded PyTorch transcription of only the official residual-block operations for zero dynamic features; not a full TiDE run, not an execution of the official TensorFlow implementation and not market training.
probe.initialization: Glorot-uniform linear matrices and zero biases, matching the Keras-style initialization assumed for the source Dense calls without overrides.
probe.conclusion: The four observed steps reduce synthetic loss through output/skip biases while hidden-bias and hidden-projection gradients remain exactly zero. This is a demonstration of degeneracy for this initialization, not a claim that the source model cannot represent a function with empty covariates.

contract_boundary.input: Seven past daily observations of OHLCV only; no target lags.
contract_boundary.adding_calendar_covariates: Calendar values can be known in advance, but supplying them introduces information outside the registered D7x5 OHLCV-only interface. It requires a prospective common-input/protocol amendment and cannot be smuggled into this compatibility restoration.
contract_boundary.adding_future_ohlcv: Real future OHLCV is unavailable at forecast time and is not admitted.
contract_boundary.adding_sigma7_history: Would change the inherited no-target-lags contract.
contract_boundary.empty_covariates_are_not_observed_zero_o: The r=0 probe uses zero-width tensors, not an invented future OHLCV observation or a zero-valued future-market sentinel.
